title: Immune composition and adenosine-associated transcription in non-small-cell lung cancer after neoadjuvant PD-1 blockade.
snippet: In non-small-cell lung cancer (NSCLC), high metabolic gene expression during immunotherapy can reflect either more infiltrating cells or altered cellular activity. We tested whether separating cell abundance from cell-intrinsic transcription clarifies incomplete tumour clearance after neoadjuvant programmed cell death-1 (PD-1) blockade. Using cross-dataset....
